answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, demanding cryptographic effort that mirrors an ivory tower of computation. By forcing agents to solve hash puzzles, the network turns the vast ocean of potential identities into a costly hurdle. This mechanism acts like a polished opal, hardening the system against cheap fake identities because an attacker must pay significant energy expenses to generate each valid signature, ensuring that influence remains tied to real physical utility.
